corpus.selection: sort every .md path by sha256(path); no outcome-dependent exclusions

same_observer_stability.view_a: exact first 1200 characters of each Markdown document
same_observer_stability.view_b: the same already-truncated excerpt with Markdown punctuation elided; lexical link labels, targets, headings and code content retained
same_observer_stability.interpretation: same-observer format-perturbation stability ceiling, not seed variability or a mathematical upper bound
same_observer_stability.conservative_joint_ceiling: minimum of the two observers' calibrated same-observer stability curves

gate.small_gallery_artifact: full calibrated mKNN < 0.20 or retention from N=116 to N=382 < 0.75; stop the static paper
gate.invalid_same_observer_stability_control: the conservative same-observer formatting reference falls below 0.50 at any of the final three N values; the control is invalid and no static claim is promoted
gate.static_shared_but_observer_specific_stru: material scale-retained alignment and a >=0.10 calibrated gap below both same-observer stability references at each of the final three N values
gate.scale_stable_but_not_separated_from_stab: alignment survives scale but the observer-specific gap gate fails; do not claim discrete observer-specific structure
